definitions.explanation: Water that has been cleaned of dirt, germs, and impurities so it is safe to drink, or the process of cleaning it. Mostly seen in compounds such as {浄水器|じょうすいき} (water filter) and {浄水場|じょうすいじょう} (water treatment plant).

examples.japanese: {浄水|じょうすい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{浄水器|じょうすいき}→浄水器：24778_jousuiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けた→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧。
examples.english: We installed a water filter in the kitchen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{浄水場|じょうすいじょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{浄水|じょうすい}⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧。
examples.english: River water is purified at a treatment plant before it reaches homes.

notes:
From {浄|じょう} (clean, pure) + {水|すい} (water).

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{浄水器|じょうすいき}→浄水器：24778_jousuiki⟧: water filter, water purifier
- {浄水場|じょうすいじょう}: water treatment plant
- {浄水|じょうすい}⟦ポット→ポット：05286_potto⟧: filter pitcher

WATCH OUT:
⟦{上水|じょうすい}→上水：20521_jousui⟧ has the same reading but means tap water supplied through pipes (as in ⟦{上水道|じょうすいどう}→上水道：16651_jousuidou⟧, the water supply system). {浄水|じょうすい} is about the cleaning, ⟦{上水|じょうすい}→上水：20521_jousui⟧ about the supply.
